title:
Epic to kickstart the deletion of a {@link Facility} or {@link ReliabilityAsset} from the Asset Hierarchy Viewer
Page by setting the entity to be deleted in {@link AssetOnboardingApplicationState} and opening the correct modal.

Payload receives the following arguments:
  - itemId: The id of the asset or facility to be deleted.
  - args: Argument payload received from the {@link AssetHierarchySpreadsheetHelper} actions that triggered this epic.
    - id: The id of the asset or facility to be deleted.
    - isFacility: Whether the item to be deleted is a facility or not.
name: HandleDeleteAssetOrFacilityInHierarchyEpic
